task:
OTHRYS TRAINING LEVEL 1 L1-033. Create exactly training/level-1/L1-033-markdown-table/markdownTable.mjs. Export markdownTable(records, options={}). records must be an array of plain objects. Empty records returns empty string. Columns default to sorted union of all record keys; options.columns may provide a non-empty array of unique non-empty strings and fixes order. Header labels equal column names. Render Markdown table with header row, separator row of --- cells, then data rows. Cell conversion: null/undefined => empty; other values String(value). Escape backslash first, then vertical bar as \|; normalize CRLF/CR/LF inside cell to literal
. Do not trim cell content. Every row must contain every selected column, using empty for missing. Output LF and no trailing newline. Reject nested objects/arrays/functions/symbols as cell values with TypeError. Deterministic, no I/O/network/deps, never mutate input. Touch no other file.
